profile.headline: Experienced Software Engineer
profile.summary: Proactive senior software engineer with over 11 years of experience developing and maintaining enterprise software systems and architecture. Hands-on expertise in C / C++ and experience in Java, Python, JavaScript. Extensive knowledge of networking, IP-based communication and protocols, multi-threaded programming, and inter-process communications. Industry experience in automotive, navigation systems, VoIP, digital TV and embedded systems. Personable team player with experience collaborating with diverse cross-functional and technical teams.

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintain and enhance the platform that enables hundreds of 3rd party Apps to run on Vizio TV's.
•	Providing network quality tracking on chromium-based SmartCast platform.
•	Design and implement rate limiter for JS analytics API.
•	Debugging, refactoring code, and conducting code reviews.

positions.title: Software Engineer (Connected car)
positions.locationName: San Francisco, California, United States · Hybrid
positions.description:
Develop and maintain connected car software which utilizes UDS diagnostic services for troubleshooting vehicle issues, over-the-air (OTA) update management, telematics data collection, remote control functionalities, and Diagnostic Trouble Code collection.
•	Integrated features of IDPS service (Intrusion Detection and Prevention system) which enables to analyze CAN frames, matching with existing DBC files to detect abnormal activities and sending warnings to the cloud.
•	Integrated DLT service (Diagnostic Log and Trace), responsible for filtering logs from different ECU apps and sending them to the cloud.
•	Automation for unit and system tests.
•	Refactor and code review.
positions.insights: Skills: C/C++ · Python · Networking (TCP/IP, FTP) · Controller Area Network (CAN) · Multithreading · Inter-process Communication · CMake · docker · Lxc · Jira · Git · RTOS · Linux · Embedded Systems · Cross Compilers

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
Developed and maintained software supporting navigation systems. Developed map data management tools, automation tools and converted digital maps (Client: Hyundai AutoEver)
•	Developed and maintained flagship navigation products for cars, indoors, ocean, and air. 
•	Implemented map displaying (OpenGL), route planning with shortest-path algorithms Dijkstra and A*; as well as route guiding, trajectory logging, and simulation functions for Windows, Android, and iOS. 
•	Developed and maintained digital map data management tools (Verification, Comparation, Statistics, Auto-Packaging…), Virtual Drive Log Tool to generate virtual logs in different formats (KML, UMT, HIPPO) through Google/HERE/T-Map JavaScript API
•	Research on fuel consumption estimation using Machine learning (Scikit-learn)
•	Interact with Ladybug camera and process images using OpenGL.
•	Implemented incremental update manager for navigation applications.
positions.insights: Skills: Android Studio · C/C++ · Java · Git · Computer Graphic (OpenGL/GLES) · Visual Studio · Linux · Eclipse · JavaScript · Inter-process Communication · Postman · Networking (TCP/IP, FTP) · Windows · Microsoft Foundation Class (MFC) · Multithreading · Jira · Embedded Systems · Tortoise SVN · MongoDB · Python · PostgreSQL

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Played key role in development of mVoIP and DTV systems. 
•	Developed Smart Pet Care System with SIP Server based on Open Source technology.
•	Developed VoIP library for mobile devices and VoIP clients. 
•	Developed DTV Electronic Program Guide SDK for mobile devices.
positions.insights: Skills: C/C++ · Digital TV · Multi-platform · Voice over IP (VoIP) · Eclipse · Computer Science · Streaming Media · XCode

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
Maintain enterprise software for managing municipal transport payment systems. 
•	Conducted coding and code review. Performed technical troubleshooting.
